name: GHB (50ml)
description:
Buy GHB (50ml) for sale

GHB (50ml) (gamma-hydroxybutyrate) is a substance that slows down the central nervous system. Sometimes used for feelings of happiness and relaxation that can be experienced. GHB has become popular as a recreational drug and can also used to aid in bodybuilding and weight loss.

People with asthma, epilepsy, diabetes, and stressed cardiovascular and psychological conditions should avoid consuming G.

Effects of GHB 50ml

GHB can lead to various dangers and negative effects:

An overdose of GHB can lead to problems like slow breathing  passing out  falling into a coma  or even dying  especially if it is taken with other drugs like alcohol or opioids.

Taking large amounts of GHB can lead to memory loss or blackouts. This means that people may struggle to remember things that happened while they were affected by the drug.
